newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timbers redeems $6.2 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timbers redeems $6.2 mln of notes.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said on Monday that it has redeemed $6.249 million of principal of its 5-1/4 convertible subordinated notes due November 1, 2003, and other notes were converted into common stock.
Payments to noteholders totaled $6.5 million, including a premium payment of $230,000 and interest due of $28,000, Cross Timbers said.
The remainder of the called notes totaling $25.6 million were converted into 1,107,477 shares of common stock, the company said.
Cross Timbers now has 17,378,205 shares and notes totaling $31.4 million outstanding, the company said.
